Great—the video player needs to be added to GitHub, then Vercel will deploy it. No Supabase SQL is needed.

  1. Download the video-player update ZIP and unzip it.
  2. Open your GitHub repository: midwifeserena/the-maternity-method.
  3. Select the branch Vercel uses for production—usually main.
  4. Click Add file → Upload files. Drag the extracted folders and files into the upload area, preserving their paths:
    • components
    • lib
    • tests
    • VIDEO_LESSONS.md
  5. Click Commit changes.
  6. Open Vercel → your project → Deployments. Wait for the new deployment to say Ready.
  7. Refresh your website’s Video Lessons page.

Upload the extracted files, not the ZIP itself. These are website code files; don’t paste them into Supabase.

If Vercel shows Error, send me the deployment’s error message so I can fix the specific problem.
